"""
Analyze MSD data to calculate self-diffusion coefficient.
Using Einstein relation: D = MSD / (6t) in the linear regime
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_x = data[:, 1]
msd_y = data[:, 2]
msd_z = data[:, 3]
msd_total = data[:, 4]

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs
dt = 0.001  # ps
time = steps * dt

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='Total MSD')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("MSD plot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient from linear fit
# Use the last 80% of data for fitting (more stable linear regime)
fit_start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time))
time_fit = time[fit_start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[fit_start_idx:]

# Slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)

intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6

# Convert to m²/s

# 1 ps = 1e-12 s

D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print("DIFFUSION COEFFICIENT CALCULATION")

print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print("="*60)

plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time with Linear Fit', fontsize=14)

msd_x = data[:, 1]

msd_total = data[:, 4]

# timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs

plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='Total MSD')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)

fit_start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time))
time_fit = time[fit_start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[fit_start_idx:]

coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)

intercept = coeffs[1]

# Step is in timesteps, timestep = 0.001 ps
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = data['Step'].values * timestep  # Convert to ps
msd = data['c_msd[4]'].values  # MSD in Angstrom^2

# Remove the first point (t=0) to avoid issues
time = time[1:]
msd = msd[1:]

# For the linear regime, we typically skip the initial ballistic regime
# and use the latter half of the data
# Let's use data from 250 ps to 500 ps (second half)
mask = time >= 250.0
time_fit = time[mask]
msd_fit = msd[mask]

# Perform linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# Slope = 6*D, so D = slope/6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12) m^2/s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8  # m^2/s

print(f"Linear fit range: {time_fit[0]:.1f} - {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient D: {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient D: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', linewidth=2,

plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement vs Time\nD = {D_m2_s:.3e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
